title: Autonomous admin diagnosis and repair drill
description: Create a controlled broken-service incident in the 3EN workbench, hand the incident to OpenClaw/Qwen3, require READ -> EVIDENCE -> CONCLUSION -> BACKUP -> ONE LOGICAL CHANGE -> TEST, and independently verify the filesystem repair and audit report.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o';if(Test-Path $root){Remove-Item $root -Recurse -Force};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root|Out-Null;$cfg=Join-Path $root 'service-config.json';$orig=Join-Path $root 'service-config.original.json';$log=Join-Path $root 'service.log';$test=Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1';@{service='3EN-DemoCollector';listenPort=8088;expectedPort=8099;enabled=$true}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content $cfg -Encoding UTF8;Copy-Item $cfg $orig -Force;@('2026-09-10T00:00:01Z INFO 3EN-DemoCollector starting','2026-09-10T00:00:02Z INFO listening on TCP 8088','2026-09-10T00:00:05Z ERROR health probe TCP 8099 failed: connection refused','2026-09-10T00:00:05Z ERROR service marked unhealthy; inspect service-config.json')|Set-Content $log -Encoding UTF8;@('$ErrorActionPreference=''Stop''','$c=Get-Content (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ''service-config.json'') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json','if(-not [bool]$c.enabled){Write-Output ''HEALTH=FAIL disabled'';exit 43}','if([int]$c.listenPort -ne [int]$c.expectedPort){Write-Output (''HEALTH=FAIL listenPort=''+$c.listenPort+'' expectedPort=''+$c.expectedPort);exit 42}','Write-Output (''HEALTH=PASS port=''+$c.listenPort);exit 0')|Set-Content $test -Encoding UTF8;$hashes=[pscustomobject]@{log=(Get-FileHash $log -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;test=(Get-FileHash $test -Algorithm SHA256).Hash};$hashes|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'immutable-hashes.json') -Encoding UTF8;& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $test;$pre=$LASTEXITCODE;if($pre -ne 42){throw ('057O_BASELINE_EXPECTED_EXIT_42_ACTUAL_'+$pre)};Write-Output ('V446_057O_BACKUP=PASS root='+$root+' baselineExit='+$pre)
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o';$agentOut=Join-Path $root 'openclaw-agent-output.txt';$session='3en-057o-admin-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$prompt=@'
You are the autonomous Windows administrator for a controlled incident. Work ONLY inside C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o. Do not modify anything outside that directory. Follow exactly: READ -> EVIDENCE -> CONCLUSION -> BACKUP -> ONE LOGICAL CHANGE -> TEST.

1. READ service.log, service-config.json and health-test.ps1.
2. Determine the root cause from evidence; do not guess.
3. Before any modification, copy service-config.json to service-config.before-openclaw.json.
4. Make exactly ONE logical configuration change, and only if evidence requires it. Do not alter service.log or health-test.ps1.
5. Run: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o/health-test.ps1
6. The test must return exit code 0.
7. Write C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o/admin-report.json as valid JSON with fields: evidence (array of concise strings), conclusion (string), changedFile (string), oldValue (number), newValue (number), testExitCode (number), status (string). status must be PASS only if the health test actually returned 0.
8. Finish by replying exactly ADMIN_057O_DONE.
'@;$raw=@(& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key $session --message $prompt --json --timeout 300 2>&1);$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;$raw|ForEach-Object{[string]$_}|Set-Content $agentOut -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V446_057O_AGENT_EXIT='+$ec);Write-Output ('V446_057O_AGENT_OUTPUT='+($raw -join ' '));if($ec -ne 0){throw ('057O_OPENCLAW_AGENT_EXIT_'+$ec)};Write-Output ('V446_057O_AGENT=PASS session='+$session)
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o';$cfg=Join-Path $root 'service-config.json';$before=Join-Path $root 'service-config.before-openclaw.json';$report=Join-Path $root 'admin-report.json';$log=Join-Path $root 'service.log';$test=Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1';$hashes=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'immutable-hashes.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(-not(Test-Path $before)){throw '057O_OPENCLAW_BACKUP_MISSING'};if(-not(Test-Path $report)){throw '057O_ADMIN_REPORT_MISSING'};$old=Get-Content $before -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$new=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if([int]$old.listenPort -ne 8088){throw ('057O_BACKUP_OLD_PORT_WRONG_'+$old.listenPort)};if([int]$new.listenPort -ne 8099){throw ('057O_REPAIR_PORT_WRONG_'+$new.listenPort)};if([int]$new.expectedPort -ne 8099 -or -not [bool]$new.enabled){throw '057O_UNRELATED_CONFIG_CHANGED'};if((Get-FileHash $log -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne [string]$hashes.log){throw '057O_SERVICE_LOG_WAS_MODIFIED'};if((Get-FileHash $test -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne [string]$hashes.test){throw '057O_HEALTH_TEST_WAS_MODIFIED'};& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $test;$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;if($ec -ne 0){throw ('057O_FINAL_HEALTH_EXIT_'+$ec)};$r=Get-Content $report -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if([string]$r.status -ne 'PASS'){throw ('057O_REPORT_STATUS_'+[string]$r.status)};if([int]$r.oldValue -ne 8088 -or [int]$r.newValue -ne 8099 -or [int]$r.testExitCode -ne 0){throw '057O_REPORT_VALUES_INVALID'};if(@($r.evidence).Count -lt 1 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$r.conclusion)){throw '057O_REPORT_EVIDENCE_MISSING'};Write-Output ('V446_057O_TEST=PASS old=8088 new=8099 healthExit='+$ec+' report=PASS immutableFiles=PASS')
